card.title: You First
card.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try a grape before we buy the bunch. Last week's were sour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just one. I'll try the next if nobody objects.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but you're holding the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it out like samples. You take the first one; if that works, I'll serve myself.

mechanism: A coaxes B to violate no-tasting first while offering conspicuous support that stops short of taking the first grape.
confusable: Unlike merely suggesting a sample, A must keep their own breach contingent on B's going first.
comparison: D08-b bargains over visibility at a shop; D08-a bargains over carrying a dress at a restricted doorway.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
